picks.why: Amazon is gutting its in-house AI division after sustained failure: most Nova models frozen, one frontier effort left under Pieter Abbeel. The clearest sign yet that a hyperscaler is conceding the general-model race.
Google's Genie 4 world model generates two-minute interactive simulations with audio and live natural-language edits - a concrete step from video generation toward usable simulated worlds.
First-person documentation of police pulling drivers over because AI scored their travel patterns as suspicious - suspicionless surveillance becoming traffic stops.
The first rigorous head-to-head of LLM bug-finding versus classic fuzzing on V8: BigSleep found more bugs than Fuzzilli, with limited overlap, so both are now standard practice.
A preprint claiming a 2^{o(n)} 3-SAT algorithm that would refute the Exponential Time Hypothesis - with the core algorithm attributed to an internal Claude research model and formalized in Lean 4.
